messages:
olivia: PTAL — addressed the review comments from earlier, updated CHANGELOG with migration notes and added a tiny compatibility shim. Removed the optional header `x-client-tag` (we fall back to legacy behavior when missing). Diff: https://git.company/repo/pull/1423/files. Need one more approver and a merge custodian; prefer canary tomorrow morning. smoke steps at bottom. thanks :pray:
dan: skimmed, looks much cleaner. quick Q: how does the shim behave for long polling clients? will it add latency?
olivia: good Q — shim is a local no-op at the server side unless header present. for long polling clients we only check a flag set during handshake; negligible cost. snippet:\n```nif req.Header.Get("x-client-tag") == "" { // legacy path
    // noop
} else {
    // new routing
}
```
jess: tiny nit in the changelog wording (s/compatability/compatibility). otherwise lgtm. can you squash the fix? :nerd_face:
olivia: fixed and squashed, pushed force. updated PR description to call out rollback steps. PTAL again @dan @mike
mike: LGTM from infra side. only ask: canary after 09:00 PST please (we have infra window).
olivia: yep can do after 09:00 PST. assigning merge custodian: @alex
alex: I can take merge custody. I'll run the smoke steps and monitor for 30m post-canary. can someone reserve the canary slot?
merge-bot: Canary slot requested by alex for PR #1423. Slot reserved: 2026-03-21T16:00:00Z. If you need to change, reply with `cancel canary` within 2h.
olivia: perfect — smoke steps (run from inside staging network):
1) deploy branch to canary pod: `make deploy-canary PR=1423`
2) curl health: `curl -H "x-env: canary" https://staging.api.internal/health` -> expect `{"status":"ok"}`
3) run a quick request to exercise header logic:
`curl -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"q":"ping"}' https://staging.api.internal/generate`
should return 200 and json with `model` key.
alex: will run after slot; will post results here.
dan: one more small question: does this require any docs change for customers?
olivia: added note in changelog and a short blurb in docs/clients.md — nothing breaking for current clients.
alex: ran smoke at canary slot, all good, health ok, sample call returned 200 and model key. monitoring 30m — no regressions seen. :thumbsup:
mike: thanks all. tagging for final approve: @dan can you give your approve when you get a sec?
dan: gave approve on the PR. merging when alex confirms post-monitoring.
olivia: thanks everyone :raised_hands:
